cases.name: Alyssa A. Jordan
cases.about: On her obituary, friend Deborah Weixeldorfer wrote: "Such a lovely person with a heart so sweet."
cases.narrative: He allegedly told police she died by suicide, claiming she shot herself in the cheek, disposed of the weapon in a nearby pond and walked back inside. Inside the kitchen, responding officers found her dead of an apparent gunshot wound.
